operations.description: Enterprise default administrator adds enterprise applications. You need record the return information after adding the application info. Then you can use the appKey and appId to  [invoke appAuth](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/zh-cn/api-meeting/meeting_21_0311.html) to get access token.
This API is used to create an enterprise, assign the default enterprise administrator, and allocate resources to the enterprise as an SP administrator.
This API is used by the default enterprise administrator to add a common enterprise administrator.

This API is used by an enterprise administrator to add a department. Up to 10 levels of departments with up to 100 sub-departments at each level can be added. By default, an enterprise can have up to 10,000 departments.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to add a hard terminal. Hard terminals include DP300, HUAWEI Bar series, HUAWEI Board, and TE series.
This API is used to add a bulletin board material.
This API is used to add a bulletin board program.
This API is used to add a bulletin board publication.

This API is used to allocate new enterprise resources. This API can also be used to modify allocated enterprise resources. If resourceId is carried in the request, Huawei Cloud Meeting Management Platform determines whether the resource exists. If the resource exists, Huawei Cloud Meeting Management Platform modifies the resource. (For details about parameters that can be modified, see the API for modifying enterprise resources.) Otherwise, Huawei Cloud Meeting Management Platform adds the resource.

This API is used to save meeting minutes to eMeetings of a user after the user scans the QR code using the Huawei Cloud Meeting app. QR code content: cloudlink://cloudlink.huawei.com/h5page?action=SAVE_MEETING_FILE&key1=value1&key2=value2. The number of keys and values may change. After parsing the request, the client saves all keys and values as a map and uses them as input parameters when initiating subsequent requests.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to add a user.
This API is used by participants to unmute themselves.

This API is used by an enterprise administrator to allocate a cloud meeting room to a user or hard terminal. Currently, only TE10, TE20, HUAWEI Board, HUAWEI Bar 500, and HUAWEI Box series hard terminals are supported. The hard terminal that the cloud meeting room is allocated to must be restarted or reactivated. To use the cloud meeting room (such as managing it and scheduling or recording meetings in it), you must allocate the cloud meeting room to a meeting user and use the cloud meeting room as the meeting user.
This API is used to delete enterprise administrators in batches.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to delete terminals in batches. A list of terminals that fail to be deleted will be returned.
This API is used to delete bulletin board materials.
This API is used to delete bulletin board programs.
This API is used to delete bulletin board publications.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to delete users in batches. If a request succeeds, all users are deleted. If a request fails, no one is deleted.
Enterprise default administrator paging query enterprise applications
Querying User Details in Batches, querying details of a specified third-party account

This API is used by an enterprise administrator to modify the terminal status in batches. If hard terminal resources expire and the number of hard terminals in the enterprise exceeds the upper limit, Huawei Cloud Meeting Management Platform automatically disables the hard terminal at random. In this case, the enterprise administrator can use this API to modify the status of hard terminals.

This API is used to modify user status in batches as an enterprise administrator. When some user account resources or third-party whiteboard resources expire and the number of user accounts or third-party whiteboard access accounts in the enterprise exceeds the upper limit, Huawei Cloud Meeting Management Platform will automatically disable the accounts at random. In this case, the enterprise administrator can use this API to modify the user status.
This API is used to broadcast a participant. Only one participant can be broadcasted at a time.
This API is used to cancel a scheduled meeting.
This API is used to cancel a recurring meeting series.
This API is used to cancel a recurring meeting.
Scenario description: When a user cascades customers to quickly join a conference, query the phone to see if they are in the conference.

This API is used to verify a puzzle piece CAPTCHA. The server receives the request and returns the verification result. Users fit the puzzle piece on the GUI, and then the server verifies the puzzle piece CAPTCHA.

This API is used to verify the validity of a token. After receiving the request, the server verifies the token validity and returns the result. If needGenNewToken is set to true, a new token is generated and returned.
This API is used to verify a verification code sent to a mobile number and email address. Up to five verification attempts per minute are allowed.
This API is used to verify a verification code. After receiving a request, the server returns the result.

This API is used to authenticate a user when the user joins a meeting anonymously. Based on the meeting ID and password authentication, an authentication random number is returned. The random number can be used to obtain anonymous user details and meeting details.

This API is used to authenticate an app ID. After the authentication is successful, an access token is generated. For details about app ID authentication, see [[Introduction to App ID Authentication](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/devg-meeting/meeting_20_0011.html)]. > * When clientType is set to 72, up to 64 tokens can be created for each user ID. If 64 tokens have been created using a user ID and the tokens are valid, creating a new token using the same user ID will invalidate the earliest token among the first 64 tokens. > * When clientType is not set to 72, only one token can be created for each user ID. > * A token is valid for 12 to 24 hours.
This API is used to obtain the meeting control authorization token of an ongoing meeting. (For a meeting that has not started, this API fails to be call.) A token is valid for half an hour.
This API is used to create an instant meeting or schedule a meeting.

This API is used to obtain a nonce for redirecting to Huawei Cloud Meeting Management Platform from the token generation page without login. After the nonce is obtained, you can redirect to the Management Platform via the link https://bmeeting.huaweicloud.com/?lang=en-US&nonce=xxxxxxxxxxxxx#/login.

This API is used to authenticate a third-party proxy account. After the authentication is successful, an access token is generated. Currently, the following third-party proxy accounts are supported: * WeLink accounts and passwords * Third-party accounts complying with OAuth 2.0
This API is used to schedule a recurring meeting series.

This API is used to authenticate Huawei Cloud Meeting account and password. After the authentication is successful, an access token is generated. > * When clientType is set to 72, up to 64 tokens can be created for each account. If 64 tokens have been created using an account and the tokens are valid, creating a new token using the same account will invalidate the earliest token among the first 64 tokens. > * When clientType is not set to 72, only one token can be created for each account. > * A token is valid for 12 to 24 hours.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to generate an activation code for smart TVs, whiteboards, and IdeaHubs.
This API is used to obtain a temporary token for establishing a WebSocket connection using the meeting control token.
Default enterprise administrator deletes enterprise applications.
This API is used to remove participants in a meeting.
This API is used by an SP administrator to delete an enterprise.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to delete a cloud meeting room in the enterprise.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to delete a department.
This API is used to delete meeting recording files in batches.
This API is used to delete enterprise resources. After resources are deleted, the total number of enterprise resources automatically decreases.
This API is used for logout. After receiving the request, the server deletes the token.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to delete activation codes.
This API is used by an administrator to delete the event push configuration.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to reclaim a cloud meeting room.
This API is used by a guest to raise or lower hands or used by the host to lower hands of all guests.
This API is used to disconnecting online participants in a meeting.
This API is used to invite a participant to enable or disable the camera as the host.
This API is used to invite participants to a meeting.
This API is used to invite a participant to share a screen or cancel invitation as the host.

This API is used to invite a user to join an enterprise using the mobile number or email address. * If the invited user does not exist in the Huawei Cloud Meeting system: - The user needs to register with Huawei Cloud Meeting to join the enterprise that uses the free or standard edition. - The user is directly added to the enterprise that uses the premium edition. The user receives the initial password of the Huawei Cloud Meeting account and needs to change the password when logging in to Huawei Cloud Meeting using the mobile number or email address. * If the invited user exists in the Huawei Cloud Meeting system, the user will receive an SMS message or email for confirmation. After accepting the invitation, the user is added to the enterprise. The password of the user account remains unchanged.
This API is used to invite a participant to a meeting using a meeting ID and password.
This interface is used to query the online attendee information of a specified conference.
This API is used to start or stop live broadcasting a meeting.
This API is used to lock or unlock a meeting. Users cannot join unlocked meetings unless they are invited by the host.
This API is used to lock or unlock the video source of an online participant who joins the meeting using a hard terminal.
This API is used by the host to mute or unmute all participants (except the host).
This API is used to mute or unmute participants as the host or mute or unmute the guest themselves as a guest.
This API is used to extend a meeting.
This API is used to start or stop recording a meeting.
This API is used to rename a specific participant.

This API is used by an enterprise administrator to reset a hard terminal activation code. The new activation code can be used to activate the hard terminal. This API can be called five times for each hard terminal every 24 hours.
Default enterprise administrator resets appKey Of enterprise application.
This API is used to reset a user password. After receiving a request, the server resets the user password and returns the result.

This API is used by an enterprise administrator to reset the password for an enterprise user. When receiving a password resetting request, the server resets the password, sends the new password to the email address or mobile number of the enterprise user, and returns the result.

This API is used by an enterprise administrator to reset an activation code. After the resetting, the original device is unbound and must be activated again. If the mobile number or email address is not specified, the new activation code will not be sent.
This API is used to give floor to a participant. Only one participant can be given the floor at a time. Only the participant who is given the floor and the host are not muted.
This API is used to query participant records of a specific historical meeting.
This API is used by an SP administrator to query enterprises in pages.
This API is used to query enterprise administrators in pages.
This API is used by an enterprise user or administrator to query the corporate directory.
This API is used by the enterprise administrator to query enterprise resource orders based on the search criteria.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to query cloud meeting rooms in the enterprise by page.
This API is used to query meeting control records of a specific historical meeting.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to query all departments by name.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to query terminals in pages.

This API is used to query all historical meetings in the management domain of an administrator or query all historical meetings managed by a common user. If no query parameter is not specified, historical meetings within the permissions scope are queried by default.
This API is used to query bulletin board materials in pages.
This API is used by a user to query meeting minutes of the user.

* This API is used to query all meetings in the management domain of an administrator or query all meetings managed by a common user. If no query parameter is carried, ongoing meetings and meeting that have not started are queried by default. * You can query only ongoing and upcoming meetings. For details about how to query historical meetings, see [[Querying the Historical Meeting List](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/api-meeting/meeting_21_0051.html)].
This API is used by an enterprise user to query cloud meeting rooms allocated to the user and the personal meeting ID.

This API is used to query all ongoing meetings in the management domain of an administrator or query all ongoing meetings managed by a common user. If no query parameter is not specified, ongoing meetings within the permissions scope are queried by default. Meeting records are sorted by start time in ascending order.
This API is used to query bulletin board programs.
This API is used to query bulletin board publications.

This API is used to query all recording files in the management domain of an administrator or query all recording files managed by a common user. If no query parameter is carried, recording files within the permissions scope are queried by default.
This API is used by an SP to query enterprise resources that match specific conditions.
This API is used by an SP to query enterprise resource operation records that match specific search criteria. Fuzzy search based on resource ID is supported.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to query enterprise users in pages.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to query activation codes by page. Fuzzy query by activation code or terminal name is supported.

This API is used to send a puzzle piece CAPTCHA. After receiving the request, the server returns the puzzle piece and original piece, which will be displayed on the frontend GUI. The enterprise user must fit the puzzle piece.

This API is used to send a verification code. A user requests to obtain a verification code after passing the verification of the puzzle piece CAPTCHA on the GUI. After receiving a request, the server sends a verification code to the email address or mobile number.

This API is used by an enterprise user to obtain a verification code for changing the mobile number or email address. After this API is called, the system sends the verification code to the user's mobile number or email address. The verification code is valid within one minute.
This API is used to customize continuous presence in a meeting.

This API is used by the host to view multiple participants in turn, view continuous presence, or focus on one participant. Currently, this API applies only to the scenario where the host joins the meeting using a hard terminal.
This API is used to set continuous presence. This API is deprecated. Use the API for [[customizing continuous presence](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/api-meeting/meeting_21_0418.html)].
This API is used by the host to focus a participant. Currently, this API applies only to the scenario where the host joins the meeting using a hard terminal.
This API is used to set the profile image of user
This API is used to apply for or relinquish the host role. Guests can apply to be the host, and the host can relinquish the host role.
This API is used to configure SSO authentication.
Set profile image for users in an enterprise. (Only the enterprise administrator can invoke this API)
This API is used by an administrator to configure event subscription in the enterprise.
This API is used by an SP administrator to query the ID of the enterprise to which a meeting belongs based on the meeting ID.
This API is used to query enterprise details as an SP administrator.
This API is used to query an enterprise administrator.
Querying Enterprise Registration Details as an Enterprise Administrator.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to query details of enterprise resources and service permissions, including used resource details.
This API is used to query department information by department code.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to query a department and its level-1 sub-departments.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to query terminal details.
This API is used to query the status of a hard terminal.The hard terminal and the account that initiates the query request must belong to the same enterprise. Otherwise, the authentication fails.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to obtain all terminal models.
This API is used to query details of all historical meetings in the management domain of an administrator or query details of all historical meetings managed by a common user.

* This API is used to query details of all meetings in the management domain of an administrator or query details of all meetings managed by a common user. * You can query only ongoing and upcoming meetings. For details about how to query details about a historical meeting, see [[Viewing Historical Meeting Details](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/api-meeting/meeting_21_0052.html)].
This API is used to query the details about a meeting minutes file.

This API is used to open the list of meeting minutes of a user after the user scans the QR code using the Huawei Cloud Meeting app. QR code content: cloudlink://cloudlink.huawei.com/h5page?action=OPEN_MEETING_FILE_LIST&key1=value1&key2=value2. The number of keys and values may change. After parsing the request, the client saves all keys and values as a map and uses them as input parameters when initiating subsequent requests.
This API is used by an enterprise user to query personal details.
This API is used to query details of all ongoing meetings in the management domain of an administrator or query details of all ongoing meetings managed by a common user.
This API is used to query the resource usage of an enterprise as the enterprise administrator.
This API is used to query program details by ID.
This API is used to query details of a publication by ID.
This API is used to query meeting details in real time.
This API is used to query details of a recording file.

This API is used to query the download links of a meeting's recording files. > * Only enterprise administrators can query download links of recording files. > * This API is available only for some enterprises. Contact Huawei sales personnel and provide your enterprise ID to apply for this API.
This API is used to query details about the region where a meeting is held. If the meeting does not exist or has not started, the corresponding error code is returned.
This API is used by an SP administrator to query the shared resource usage of the SP.
This API is used by an SP administrator to query all resources of the SP, including used resources.
This API is used to query the SSO authentication configuration.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to query details about an enterprise user.
This API is used by an administrator to query the event subscription configuration in the enterprise.
This API is used to activate a meeting using the meeting ID and host password.
This API is used to end a meeting.
This API is used by an administrator to switch the video display mode, including fixed participant broadcast and voice activation.
Default enterprise administrator modifies enterprise applications.

This API is used to change the mobile number or email address. You must obtain the verification code first. If the verification fails for multiple times, the mobile number or email address cannot be changed.
This API is used to modify an enterprise. If a parameter is null or is not carried, the parameter is not modified.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to modify enterprise registration details. Currently, only the enterprise address can be modified.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to modify a department.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to modify a terminal.
This API is used to update a bulletin board material.

This API is used to modify a scheduled meeting. Ongoing meetings cannot be modified. > When modifying meeting parameters, configure all the parameters required for scheduling the meeting. If you only specify the parameters to be modified, other parameters will be restored to the default values.
This API is used by an enterprise user to modify information of cloud meeting rooms allocated to the user and personal meeting ID.
This API is used by an enterprise user to modify personal details.
This API is used to update a bulletin board program.
This API is used to modify a bulletin board publication.
This API is used by an enterprise user to change the password. When the server receives a request, it changes the password and returns the result.
This API is used to edit an upcoming recurring meeting series.
This API is used to edit an upcoming recurring meeting.
This API is used to modify the expiration time and suspension status of enterprise resources.
This API is used to modify meeting settings as the host, including whether to lock meeting sharing and participants who can join the meeting.
This API is used to update the validity period of a token.
This API is used by an enterprise administrator to modify a user.
This API is used by an administrator to change the subscription configuration status.
